newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo rises on hopes of larger sales.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo rises on hopes of larger sales.

text.p: Shares in Nintendo Co Ltd recovered sharply on Monday morning, helped by hopes that the firm's decision to cut the domestic price of its 64-bit game machine Nintendo64 would boost its sales, brokers said.
At 0052 GMT, the share price was up 90 yen at 8,390 yen on volume of 69,600 shares.
On Friday, Nintendo said it would cut the domestic price of the Nintendo64 player to 16,800 yen from 25,000 yen on March 14.

The leading maker of home video game machines and software also said on Friday that it expects to post a parent current profit of around 100 billion yen in the year to March 31 if the dollar stays at around 123 yen, up from its November forecast for 1996/97 of 85 billion yen.
